title: TPC-C prepared Payment transaction and production gate sampling
scope: TPC-C Payment latency/stability and production medium gate evidence quality
constraints: Do not relax suite latency/throughput thresholds
Do not add Payment or newly observed cases to the allowlist to force a pass
Keep production verification on scale=medium suite=production load_mode=insert
Use production medium gate as authoritative verifier

steps.step: Diagnose production gate noise from low per-case sample count
Add production gate minimum case sample check
Run high-sample production repeat and gate

benchmark_changes: converted tpcc:Payment transaction from three independent HTTP /query calls to one parameterized prepared multi-statement /execute call
suppressed unused Payment result payloads with return_results=false
documented --iters 60 --warmup 5 for production gate repeat runs
tests: python -m py_compile fusiondb_bench.py bench_repeat.py bench_stability.py bench_gate.py fusiondb_matrix.py
